title: My Morning Menu — Daily Calendar & Weather Circle Time Workbook

overview.description: 13-page daily morning routine workbook. Includes: name writing page, date selector (month/day/year/day of week), season & weather tracker (temperature categories: hot/warm/cold/cool; weather types: sunny/cloudy/rainy/snowy/windy/stormy). Designed for daily circle time or morning meeting — the child fills it out each morning as part of a consistent routine. Teaches calendar skills, weather awareness, and establishes predictable daily structure.

gaps.name: daily-morning-menu
gaps.description: Reusable daily circle time page: date selector, weather tracker, season indicator, name practice. Could be generated fresh each morning with pre-filled date options for the current week/month. Laminate-and-reuse or print-daily format.

dailyRitual.description: Not a one-time worksheet — this is a daily routine tool. The child fills it out EVERY morning as part of morning meeting/circle time.
dailyRitual.value: Routine-building tool that teaches through repetition. Calendar, weather, and name-writing skills develop through daily practice, not isolated worksheets.

notes: Pairs with the Daily Rhythm Cards drop. Aless clearly values structured daily routines as a learning framework. Both drops are about making the day predictable and embedding skills into the routine itself.
